description: Your account's own email and phone number, which the site may use to reach you about your entries and prizes. Only your account and the site's admins see them (never on a public page, a leaderboard, the archive, an export or another tool); they are not your sign-in. Answers each value (email trimmed with its domain lowercased, phone in E.164), when it was verified, when a code sent to it expires, and the channels this server can send codes on (verify_channels; empty: none). Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401. Verify one over HTTP: POST /api/me/contact/<email|phone>/send sends a 6-digit code to it, POST /api/me/contact/<email|phone>/confirm with {"code"} confirms it.
name: get_contact
title: Your contact
